text: Gree Electric Appliances has had neither a controlling shareholder nor an actual controller since the state-owned Zhuhai Gree Group's transfer of 15% of its shares to Zhuhai Mingjun was registered in 2020. At the end of 2025, Zhuhai Mingjun held 16.11%, Jinghai Internet 7.83% and Zhuhai Gree Group, a state-owned legal person, 3.46%; Gree Group still held 3.46% at 30 June 2026.

source.name: Gree Electric Appliances, Inc. of Zhuhai, 2025 Annual Report (English version, CNINFO filing)
source.quote: After the completion of the share transfer registration, the Company has neither a controlling shareholder nor an actual controller.
